token.title: 🔑 GitHub tukin
token.intro: GitHub ukax horan 60 mayiwinakakiw kutt'ayi janiw tukin apayki uka utjawiru. Mä phuqhat t'aqa quqax niya 32 manq'i, ukatwa payïr visitanx tukusi. Tukinax thiyap horan 5000 ukar jach'achi.
token.step1: Jist'aram Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, ukat Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: juman pachpa cuentama. Expiration: kuna urus, quqax janiw jaya jakirinak munkiti.
token.step4: Taqi iyawsawinak jan llamkt'asa jaytam. Taqinitak imañanakan metayatiyawipax janiw maynirus munkiti.
token.step5: Luram, ukat {token} chanip qillqaqam. GitHub ukax mä kutikiw uñacht'ayi.
token.classic: Nayra tukinas walikiwa: jan kuna iyawsaw ajllisa maya luram. Ch'usa iyawsawix taqinitak yatiyawinak uñt'at jank'amp liyiskakiwa.
token.stays: Aka web thaqhirinw {key} jist'arañamp qhiparaski, {host} ukarukiw saraski. Janipuniw utjaw barrar qillqatäkiti, ukatwa jaljt'ata chinumax uñtaw api, janiw uñt'ayasiwxa. Ch'iqa aynachan utjki uka butunax cachemp chika wasitat pichi.
token.persistHow: Tukin uchaña aka laphi imiri sirwidurn {env} qillqatapar, {port} jak'ana:
token.proxy: ukat {make} ukamp qalltayam. Ukatx contenedorax mä nginx t'aqa qillqi, uka t'aqax {header} p'iqi {path} proxy ukar mayachi; ukatwa web thaqhirix pachpa qalltawip jawsi, janipuniw tukin katuqkiti. Aka ch'iqax chhaqtaniwa, taqi visitirinakax horan 5000 mä sapa qullqi jaljasipxi.
fork.refused404: Janiw rama siqinakax utjkiti: {message}. Akan 404 ukax jan utjir ramawa jan ukax sirwidur proxyn jan apkaya thakhiwa; alaxan t'aqa llikax kunjamarus phuqhatawa.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ukax aka horatakix mayiwinak tukuyxiwa, ukatwa janiw rama siqinak siq'iñjamäkänti. Alaxan t'aqa llikax phuqhatawa. Susuña panelan tukin yapxatam, jan ukax uñnaqa panelan rama siqinak jiwayam, qullqi llikakikiru tukjañataki.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ukax mayjt'aw sarnaqäwinakatakix {status} sasaw kutt'ayäna, ukatwa janiw rama siqinak siq'iñjamäkänti. Alaxan t'aqa llikax phuqhatawa.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Uñt'ayirix janiw uruninakiti, ukatwa qhipharapirinakax sapa mayniw mä mayiwi manq'ipxaspa, horan qhiparir qullqipax janiw ukatak tukjatäkiti.
